name: Chennai
tagline: World-Class Healthcare and Coastal Calm on the Bay of Bengal
description: Chennai is South India's cultural and economic anchor, a Bay of Bengal capital where Tamil temple traditions, a thriving auto and IT industry, and some of the country's best hospitals all converge. Known as the 'Health Capital of India,' the city is home to Apollo Hospitals and a dense cluster of internationally accredited medical centers, making it a natural fit for retirees who prioritize healthcare access. Coastal neighborhoods along the Marina and East Coast Road offer a calmer, more laid-back pace than Delhi or Mumbai, with a strong Tamil cultural identity running through daily life. Heat and humidity are constant companions, but the combination of medical infrastructure and low costs is difficult to match elsewhere in Asia.

quickFacts.visa: India has no retirement, pension, or passive-income visa. US citizens use the e-Tourist visa — 30-day (multiple-entry) or 1-year/5-year (multiple-entry; the 5-year fee rose from $80 to $200 in 2026) — and may stay up to 180 days per visit, with total time capped at 180 days per calendar year; long-term residents get by cycling visas in and out. The only path to living in India indefinitely is the OCI card, open to people of Indian origin or those married 2+ years to an Indian citizen or OCI holder.
quickFacts.internetSpeed: 60–100 Mbps typical; fiber widely available to 1 Gbps
quickFacts.safetyRating: One of India's safer big cities, often rated good for women; heat, monsoon flooding, and traffic are the practical concerns
quickFacts.climate: Tropical and coastal — hot and humid most of the year with an October–December northeast monsoon

housing.description: Modest 1BHK in a decent area (Velachery / Anna Nagar or Adyar edge)

dining.description: Tamil thalis, dosa counters, casual restaurants; occasional nicer meal

healthcare.description: Individual mediclaim with Apollo/MIOT access — assumes an early retiree (45–55); older retirees should budget more

transportation.description: Chennai Metro + MTC bus pass + autos/ride-hail

entertainment.description: Marina Beach, temples, Carnatic concerts, cinema

1M.lifestyle: A very affordable life anchored by healthcare peace of mind — a modest 1BHK, metro-and-auto mobility, thali/dosa eating, and individual cover giving access to some of India’s best hospitals (Apollo, MIOT). Heat and humidity are constant, and A/C makes utilities the one line that runs higher than the cooler metros.

housing.description: Spacious 3BR apartment in Besant Nagar or Nungambakkam

dining.description: Regular dining at Besant Nagar's beachside cafes and Nungambakkam's restaurant scene

healthcare.description: Premium insurance covering Apollo, Fortis Malar, and other top-tier hospitals

transportation.description: Own small car or regular Uber/Ola; metro for convenience

entertainment.description: Beach evenings at Besant Nagar, classical dance performances, weekend trips to Mahabalipuram, gym membership

2M.lifestyle: A spacious 3-bedroom apartment in Besant Nagar or Nungambakkam, dining regularly at beachside cafes and Nungambakkam's restaurant scene, and your own small car or frequent Uber. Premium health insurance covering Apollo and Fortis Malar hospitals. Weekend trips to the shore temples of Mahabalipuram are easy and affordable. Day-to-day life is comfortable with a solid financial cushion each month. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Good 1BHK / compact 2BHK in Besant Nagar, Nungambakkam, or along ECR

dining.description: Regular dining at beachside cafés and Nungambakkam restaurants

transportation.description: Own small car or frequent ride-hail

3M.lifestyle: Comfortable coastal living — a good flat near the beach or along ECR, regular dining out, a car or unlimited ride-hail, and weekend trips down the coast. Best-in-class hospital access removes the main tail risk; A/C keeps utilities above the cooler metros.

housing.description: Expansive villa along ECR (East Coast Road) or a penthouse in Nungambakkam

dining.description: Personal chef for daily meals, fine dining several times per week, catered events

healthcare.description: VIP concierge medical with dedicated physician; direct access to Apollo's international patient wing

transportation.description: Luxury sedan with full-time chauffeur, domestic flights, occasional chartered travel

entertainment.description: Premium club memberships, art collecting, private Margazhi season boxes, weekend Pondicherry retreats

domesticHelp.description: Full-time cook, housekeeper, driver, and gardener

luxuryExtras.description: Business-class international travel, luxury resort stays, property investments

5M.lifestyle: An expansive villa along ECR or a penthouse in Nungambakkam, a luxury sedan with full-time driver, and a housekeeper, cook, and gardener. Regular fine dining across the city and business-class flights for longer trips. Premium healthcare with a dedicated physician and direct access to Apollo's international patient wing. Chennai's low costs relative to this budget mean a very large monthly margin, even living at the top end of the market. (Interpolated tier.)

healthcare.description: International cover; Apollo international patient wing

domesticHelp.description: Cook + housekeeper scaled to one home

10M.lifestyle: Luxury with a medical moat — a large ECR villa or penthouse, a driver, a cook and housekeeper, international cover anchored by Apollo, and a strong travel budget. The coastal heat means A/C-driven utilities run higher at this level than in India’s cooler metros.
